title: Best Whirlpool Dehumidifier (2026): 50-Pint With Pump & More
h1: The Best Whirlpool Dehumidifiers, From the 20-Pint to the 50-Pint With Pump
dek: A household name you already trust for washers and fridges — here's which of its dehumidifiers actually fits your damp room.
description: Shopping for a Whirlpool 50-pint dehumidifier with pump? We rank Whirlpool's 20-, 25-, 32- and 50-pint models and explain AccuDry, 70-pint labels and manuals.
intro: If you're searching for a **Whirlpool 50-pint dehumidifier with pump**, you probably have a basement with no floor drain and a name you'd rather trust than gamble on. Good news: that's exactly the model we'd point most Whirlpool shoppers to. It's ENERGY STAR certified, and its built-in pump pushes water up to a sink or out a window, so you can stop hauling buckets.

Whirlpool's current dehumidifier lineup on Amazon is short and easy to shop: a 20-pint portable for small rooms, ENERGY STAR 25- and 32-pint models for bedrooms and mid-size spaces, and the 50-pint pump unit for basements. The two things that matter most when choosing between them are **size** (how damp and how big the space is) and **drainage** (bucket, gravity hose or pump).

Below, we rank all four Whirlpool models, add one smart alternative, and sort out the older names still common in searches — AccuDry, Gold Series and the 70-pint WDH70EAPW — plus manual, parts and filter help.
topPicksLead: For basements and large damp rooms, the **Whirlpool 50-Pint ENERGY STAR Dehumidifier with Pump** is the Whirlpool to buy: the most capacity in the lineup and a pump that drains it for you.

items.label: Whirlpool dehumidifiers on Amazon right now
Pints per day across the lineup

blocks.text: Three of the four models — the 25-, 32- and 50-pint — carry the ENERGY STAR label on their listings. The 20-pint portable is the older, simpler design for when space and budget matter more than capacity.

We don't lab-test. We compared Whirlpool's listed capacities and certifications against how the DOE 2019 test and ENERGY STAR criteria work, searched the CPSC database for recalls of Whirlpool-branded dehumidifiers, and read owner reviews for recurring issues such as noisy compressors, bucket leaks and pump problems.
Where a listing doesn't publish a figure — bucket size, decibels, coverage — we say so rather than guess. Every pick, including the one alternative, is available on Amazon.

sections.heading: How to choose a Whirlpool dehumidifier

items.label: Size it to the dampness, not just the floor area
items.text: A single bedroom or office: 20–25 pints. A large living area or finished basement: about 32 pints. A damp or musty basement, or anything over about 1,500 square feet: 50 pints. Our [dehumidifier size guide](/guides/dehumidifier-size-guide/) walks through the math.

items.label: Decide how the water leaves
items.text: Bucket-only works for bedrooms. In a basement, either run a gravity hose to a floor drain or buy the 50-pint pump model so water can travel up to a sink or out a window.

items.label: Check the ENERGY STAR label
items.text: A dehumidifier can run for hundreds of hours a season. The ENERGY STAR 25-, 32- and 50-pint models remove more water per kilowatt-hour; our guide to [how much electricity a dehumidifier uses](/guides/how-much-electricity-does-a-dehumidifier-use/) shows what that means on your bill.

items.label: Think about noise and placement
items.text: Every compressor unit hums. In a bedroom, choose the smallest model that keeps up, and leave a few inches of clearance around the intake and exhaust.

items.label: Know what controls you need
items.text: A humidity setpoint, a timer and auto shut-off are the essentials. Whirlpool's listings don't advertise an app, so look at a smart alternative if you want phone alerts.

sections.heading: Which Whirlpool dehumidifier should you buy?

items: **Damp basement with no floor drain:** the Whirlpool 50-Pint with Pump. See our [best dehumidifier for basement](/best/best-dehumidifier-for-basement/) guide for placement tips.
**Damp basement with a floor drain and a love of apps:** the Midea Cube 50, run on a gravity hose.
**Finished basement, family room or open-plan living area:** the Whirlpool 32-Pint.
**Bedroom, nursery-adjacent office or bathroom:** the Whirlpool 25-Pint, set to about 45–50%.
**Laundry nook, closet-heavy room or a tight budget:** the Whirlpool 20-Pint Portable.
**Replacing an old 70-pint Whirlpool:** a 50-pint model today removes roughly what a 70-pint did under the old test, so the 50-pint pump model is the like-for-like swap.

sections.heading: Whirlpool AccuDry, Gold Series and the 70-pint WDH70EAPW

blocks.text: **AccuDry** was the name Whirlpool used for the humidity-control system on many earlier dehumidifiers, and **Gold Series** was its premium appliance trim of that era. Neither name appears in the current Amazon lineup, but the same filter, coil and drainage care applies.

Models like the **WDH70EAPW** were sold as 70-pint units under the pre-2019 test, which measured capacity in hot, humid air. In 2019 the DOE moved to cooler conditions closer to a real basement, and the same hardware now rates far lower: a former 70-pint machine is roughly equivalent to a 50-pint model today. That's why you won't find a new Whirlpool 70-pint dehumidifier — the class didn't disappear, it got renamed. Our [best 70-pint dehumidifier](/best/best-70-pint-dehumidifier/) guide explains the change in detail.

blocks.title: Check older units for recalls
blocks.text: Whirlpool-branded dehumidifiers have been included in past CPSC recalls. If you own an older unit, look up its full model and serial number on the CPSC website before you keep running it.

sections.heading: Whirlpool dehumidifier manual, buttons, parts and filter

blocks.text: The model number is your key to everything else. Find it on the rating label on the back or side of the cabinet, often behind the bucket, then search that exact number on Whirlpool's owner-support site for the user manual, user guide and parts list.

Layouts vary by model, but most Whirlpool panels cover power, a humidity setpoint you raise or lower, fan speed, a timer and a full-bucket or filter indicator. If the display shows an unfamiliar code, check your model's manual before assuming the unit has failed.
Cleaning the filter and finding parts

Slide out the washable mesh filter every two to four weeks in heavy use, rinse it in lukewarm water, let it dry and reinstall it. A clogged filter is a common reason a unit stops collecting water; our [replacement filter guide](/guides/dehumidifier-replacement-filter/) covers when to replace rather than wash. Order buckets, floats, hoses and pump parts by full model number, since parts differ between generations.

For most homes, the **Whirlpool 50-Pint ENERGY STAR Dehumidifier with Pump** is the Whirlpool worth buying: real basement capacity and a pump that ends bucket duty. Step down to the **32-Pint** for living areas and finished basements, the **25-Pint** for bedrooms, or the **20-Pint Portable** for one small room. If app control matters more than the badge on the front, the **Midea Cube 50** is the stronger smart pick. Still deciding between brands? Our [best dehumidifier brands](/best/best-dehumidifier-brands/) guide puts Whirlpool in context.

faqs.q: Is the Whirlpool 50-pint dehumidifier with pump worth it?
faqs.a: For a basement without a floor drain, yes. The built-in pump lets you send water up to a sink or out a window, and it's the only ENERGY STAR Whirlpool in the lineup with basement-class capacity. If you have a floor drain and don't need the pump, a gravity-drain 50-pint is a simpler alternative.

faqs.q: Does Whirlpool still make a 70-pint dehumidifier?
faqs.a: Not under that label. After the DOE changed its test in 2019, former 70-pint units are rated at roughly 50 pints. Whirlpool's 50-pint with pump is the modern equivalent of an older Whirlpool 70-pint such as the WDH70EAPW.

faqs.q: What is a Whirlpool AccuDry dehumidifier?
faqs.a: AccuDry was the name of the humidity-control system on many earlier Whirlpool dehumidifiers. Those models are no longer the current lineup, but you can usually still find their manuals by searching the full model number on Whirlpool's support site.

faqs.q: Where can I find a Whirlpool dehumidifier manual or user guide?
faqs.a: Look for the model number on the label on the back or side of the cabinet, often behind the bucket, then search it on Whirlpool's owner-support site. The manual covers the buttons, drainage setup, filter cleaning and error codes for your exact model.

faqs.q: How do I clean a Whirlpool dehumidifier filter?
faqs.a: Pull out the mesh filter, rinse it in lukewarm water, let it dry completely and slide it back in. Do it every two to four weeks during humid months, or whenever the filter indicator comes on.
